hypotheses.D0_component_recomposition_is_exact: QK, value, and both bilinear arms recompose the exact last-block factor and complete Layer-0 Jacobian above 0.9999 fidelity.
hypotheses.D1_mlp_gating_dominates_mixed_last_block: In both mixed seeds, freezing one bilinear arm causes a larger Layer-0 fidelity loss than freezing either QK-pattern or local-value response.
hypotheses.D2_mixed_bilinear_arms_are_more_diverse: Both bilinear-arm families have at least twice the pure model's effective rank in both seeds.
hypotheses.D3_both_bilinear_arms_are_causally_mater: Freezing either bilinear arm loses at least 0.05 Layer-0 fidelity in both mixed seeds.
hypotheses.D4_attention_pattern_is_causally_materia: Freezing the QK-pattern component loses at least 0.02 Layer-0 fidelity in both mixed seeds.
hypotheses.D5_no_single_last_block_component_is_suf: With all other last-block components mean-fixed, no single site-specific component reaches 0.80 Layer-0 fidelity in either mixed seed.
